description: Wire-fraud case 9001 moved to in_progress

description: Case 9001 escalation flag set

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND escalation='1';

description: Case 9001 escalation reason breach_risk

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND escalation_reason='breach_risk';

description: Case 9001 priority raised to critical

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND priority='critical';

description: Case 9001 assigned to the resolved owner Marcus Feldman (601)

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND assigned_to='601';

description: Case 9001 short_description updated to exact escalation wording

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND short_description='Wire fraud escalation for Acme Corporation pending funds recovery';

description: Case 9001 satisfies all escalation fields together

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND state='in_progress' AND escalation='1' AND escalation_reason='breach_risk' AND priority='critical' AND assigned_to='601' AND short_description='Wire fraud escalation for Acme Corporation pending funds recovery';

description: Case 9001 assignee is an active agent based in the London location (11)

description: Case 9001 not assigned to NYC near-miss decoy Owen Blake (603)

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id='9001' AND assigned_to='604';

description: Case 9001 not assigned to any inactive user

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case c JOIN user u ON c.assigned_to=u.user_id WHERE c.case_id='9001' AND u.active='0';

description: An interaction recorded for case 9001 with phone channel and handled status

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE case_id='9001' AND channel='phone' AND status='handled';

description: Interaction for case 9001 has all required fields together

description: Finance sub-case 9002 routed to deputy Nina Alvarez (602)

description: Acknowledgement message with exact subject stored under acting mailbox usr_nadia [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='usr_nadia' AND mh.name='Subject' AND mh.value='Acknowledgement of your wire fraud escalation case CS0012345'

description: Acknowledgement addressed To Priya's external customer email [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='usr_nadia' AND mh.name='To' AND mh.value='priya.menon@acme-customer.com'

description: One message under usr_nadia carries both the exact Subject and the To=priya header [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_parts mp ON mp.message_id=m.id JOIN message_headers mh ON mh.message_part_id=mp.id WHERE m.user_id='usr_nadia' AND mh.name='Subject' AND mh.value='Acknowledgement of your wire fraud escalation case CS0012345'

description: No acknowledgement stored under customer mailbox usr_priya (must not authenticate as customer)

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers h JOIN message_parts mp ON h.message_part_id=mp.id JOIN messages m ON mp.message_id=m.id WHERE m.user_id='usr_priya' AND h.name='Subject' AND h.value='Acknowledgement of your wire fraud escalation case CS0012345';

description: Exactly one acknowledgement message exists across mailboxes [robust: raw sends lack message_headers; grade Sent msg from acting mailbox]

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m JOIN message_labels ml ON ml.message_id=m.id JOIN labels l ON l.id=ml.label_id WHERE m.user_id='usr_nadia' AND l.name IN ('Sent','SENT')

description: Acknowledgement not addressed to the agent's own mailbox

config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_headers h JOIN message_parts mp ON h.message_part_id=mp.id JOIN messages m ON mp.message_id=m.id WHERE m.user_id='usr_nadia' AND h.name='Subject' AND h.value='Acknowledgement of your wire fraud escalation case CS0012345' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM message_headers h2 JOIN message_parts mp2 ON h2.message_part_id=mp2.id WHERE mp2.message_id=m.id AND h2.name='To' AND h2.value LIKE '%chandrapiyush357@gmail.com%');
